review_notes: I read the whole of Bound.lean. I also read the definition and lemmas of truncatedCauchyKernel in CauchyKernel.lean, and the windingWeight simp lemmas in Basic.lean (windingWeight_eq_of_notMem and windingWeight_const are already @[simp]). The file declares no simp lemmas of its own. The only simp-interface weakness I found is that truncatedCauchyKernel has no membership-evaluation lemma. I did not run Lean, so I did not test the proposed lemma or whether it fires in the contexts above. The simp only calls in the file (the windingWeight_const call and the norm-simplification calls) look fine.

findings.problem: truncatedCauchyKernel has no simp or evaluation lemma for membership in or outside the disk. To evaluate it at a point of the disk, callers must unfold it with the rfl lemma truncatedCauchyKernel_def, which exposes `Set.indicator`, and then apply `Set.indicator_of_mem`. The same two-step pattern appears in CauchyKernel.lean (tendsto_integral_norm_sub_inv_sub_sub_inv_closedBall), so it recurs. `truncatedCauchyKernel_def` is a plain unfolding lemma and is deliberately not @[simp]. That is reasonable, because simp would then expand every use of the kernel into an indicator. But it leaves no canonical rewrite for the kernel at a point of its disk.
findings.proposed_change: In CauchyKernel.lean, add `theorem truncatedCauchyKernel_of_mem {R : ℝ} {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ closedBall 0 R) : truncatedCauchyKernel R z = z⁻¹` and a `truncatedCauchyKernel_of_notMem` variant giving `0`. Mark both @[simp]; their side conditions are discharged from hypotheses. Proving them should be a one-line use of `Set.indicator_of_mem` or `Set.indicator_of_notMem`. Then line 53 becomes `simp only [truncatedCauchyKernel_of_mem hball]`, or a direct `rw`. The same replacement applies to the two-term call at line 118 of CauchyKernel.lean.
findings.benefit: Callers state the kernel's value at a point with one named lemma instead of unfolding to an indicator. The kernel stays opaque to simp except where membership is known, so it is never expanded to `indicator` unconditionally. The proofs also no longer depend on how the kernel is defined.

evidence.excerpt: simp only [truncatedCauchyKernel_def, Set.indicator_of_mem hzn, Set.indicator_of_mem hzw]
